NDT Training and Certification in Ruwais — UAE

Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT and ISO 9712 aligned NDT training in Ruwais: Level I, Level II and Level III programmes across ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and visual testing, plus API 510, API 570 and API 653 inspector preparation. Courses are authored and supervised by ASNT NDT Level III professionals.

The Ruwais inspection market

Ruwais is ADNOC's industrial city in Al Dhafra Region — home to ADNOC Refining Ruwais (the world's fourth-largest single-site refinery at 922,000 bpd), Borouge polyolefins complex (ADNOC + Borealis), Fertiglobe, and the Ta'ziz chemicals zone. Long-term framework NDT volume sits with Applus+ Velosi, TÜV Rheinland, Bureau Veritas, and Mistras Middle East against ADNOC-VR specifications.

Certifications most in demand in Ruwais

Primary: ASNT. Secondary: ISO 9712. Also frequently requested: PCN, CSWIP.

Recommended certification pathway

ADNOC Refining and Borouge enforce ASNT SNT-TC-1A together with ADNOC-VR-NDT specifications. CSWIP 3.1 is mandatory for welding inspection at EPC capital projects led by Tecnimont, Samsung Engineering, and Petrofac.

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.
